responsibility: This source file implements the MIPS gcc driver helper for -march=native and -mtune=native on native MIPS hosts. Through host_detect_local_cpu, it inspects /proc/cpuinfo and auxiliary platform information, maps detected CPUs such as Loongson, SB1, R5000, and Octeon to GCC’s accepted processor names, appends nan=2008 handling when required, and returns replacement driver options for use by the spec-function hook in GNU-user configurations.
